name: ANU Community Connect Food Relief
summary: Ongoing food relief for ANU students identified with food insecurity, plus free period packs on campus.
who: Students that are HEPPP-eligible can receive ongoing food relief support
Students who are not HEPPP-eligible may still qualify
how: Email student.life@anu.edu.au to ask about food relief or check eligibility

evidence.quote: The Community Connect Food Relief service is for eligible students identified with food insecurity.
Students that are HEPPP-eligible can receive ongoing food relief support.
